digest.component_or_area: rebar Bedrock LLM provider region configuration (review-bot service)
propositions: The review-bot container has no AWS region configured, so Bedrock client construction hard-fails with NoRegionError before any model call.
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, falling through to boto3 resolution which finds no region.
The escaping exception is a pydantic-ai UserError that is not a subclass of rebar's LLMError, so the fail-closed handler does not catch it and the LLM-Review gate goes down for every landing.
The provider should raise a typed LLMConfigError naming REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, catchable by existing fail-closed handling, rather than a message referencing a pydantic-ai kwarg.
AWS_REGION alone does not resolve on this botocore; only AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (or the config file) supplies a region, and docstrings claiming otherwise are inaccurate.

IMDS reachability supplies credentials but never a region, so region configuration and the IMDS hop-limit contingency are independent concerns, and setting the region also un-breaks CloudWatch voter metrics.
